in_sanskrit.name: विष्णुर्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has the power of Lord Vishnu

in_marathi.name: Vishnurya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vishnurya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vishnurya is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Vishnu' (the preserver god in Hinduism) and 'Shakti' (divine power).

in_bengali.name: Vishnurya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Divine Power
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vishnurya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Vishnurya is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Vishnu' (the preserver god in Hinduism) and 'Shakti' (divine power).
